Name: Orbs of Spelljamming
Components: V, S, M (a collection of gemstones worth at least 10 gp each, equal in number to the number of orbs you create, which the spell consumes)
Description:
You conjure four pristine orbs of clear ice, each invested with a small amount of magical energy that softly glows within it.

For the duration, if you are targeted by a spell, you can expend a number of these orbs to absorb magical energy from the incoming spell. Apply the following effects in order:
● Negate the spell. If you expend a number of orbs equal to the spell's level, the spell fails and those orbs are destroyed.
● Reduce an upcast spell. If you do not have enough orbs to negate the spell outright and the spell was cast using a higher-level spell slot than its base level, the first orbs expended reduce the spell slot used by one level per orb until it reaches the spell's base level.
● Reduce damage. If the spell is not negated, is at its base level, and would deal damage to you, your remaining orbs are consumed. Roll 1d10 for each orb expended and reduce the spell's damage by the total rolled. If this reduces the initial damage to 0, the spell has no further effect on you.
● Improve your saving throw. If the spell is not negated, is at its base level, and does not deal damage, each time you roll and fail the saving throw against it, one orb is consumed. You then reroll 1d20 and recalculate the saving throw using the new result. This repeats until you succeed or run out of orbs.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, it creates one additional orb for each slot level above 2nd.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
